text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And claiming victory in the BNW showdown is—
Narita Taishin!!
It's Narita Taishin!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Ah... it doesn't hurt. It feels so good.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(I really do want to win in races.
I want to keep winning until I can finally believe in myself.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Still, the reason this "victory" feels so sweet
and makes me so happy is――)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I'm zo maaaad...!!
I gave it everything, super-duper everything, and I still lost!"

"Standing at the pinnacle of BNW was Narita Taishin.
The cheers praising her echoed on and on,
never seeming to fade..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
choice_data_list: Yeah, which one do you want?!
Yeah, which one do you want?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You're way too hyper.
As annoying as ever, aren't you? Not that I mind, though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Now that you've made it this far, you want to run, don't you?
In the year-end Grand Prix race—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "Ticket and Hayahide will probably be running too, after all."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I want to test it. Test it, and make sure.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: The strength in me that you believe in.
The next goal has been set on the Arima Kinen!
